source.regression: parseRows' row regex required a lookahead after the captured , so its lazy ([\s\S]*?) ran past the end of row 1. Measured against that regex: a 1-row payload parsed to 0 collections, 2 rows to 1, 3 rows to 2, 4 rows to 3 -- always N-1, because the final row has no terminator to satisfy the lookahead. parseRows now splits on the row opener, so all 6 rows are read. This fixture is what proves it: three distinct streams on three distinct weekdays, each with a weekly cadence.
